How to run the refund matrix
SPT-5308 shipping/fee settings plus customer preview and completed-return checks; CAD; 2026-10-13.
Filter Refund runs to Priority = Test now: F01/F02/F03 are flat rate with 2 or 3 tickets.
G01/G02 cover Per item group type; I01/I02 cover Per item. F04 is an unequal-rate flat-rate check.
Type A and Type B are distinct ticket types in the same order. A1/A2/B1 identify individual tickets, not real barcodes.
10.00 per configured charge; F04 uses A=10.00 and B=15.00. Each ticket is planned at 20.00.
Use compatible new itemized ticket orders, amount rules enabled and Delivery. No discounts, packages, credit funding or shipping overrides/quantity-limit suppression.
Save the row’s shipping rule and fee choices. Use an independent new order for each unique Run ID. Steps sharing a Run ID belong to one order.

In Purchase amounts, enter each group’s original subtotal, item HST, organizer fee/HST, Showpass + VAT, processing + VAT and service charges. Enter 0 when genuinely absent. Prefilled subtotal/HST are planned values until verified.
Each repeat must match the saved group amounts. If a purchase differs, save a separate copy and rebaseline its inputs; changing shared inputs recalculates all matching setup rows.
Enter actual original shipping and shipping HST in columns P/Q. Blank uses planned values; entered zero is preserved. Mark proof Invoice verified only after purchase evidence.
Use invoice service_charges_stat: organizer fee plus Showpass/processing including their VAT, excluding organizer fee HST. Do not copy basket service_fees without adjusting its VAT presentation.
Multi-ticket fee values are deliberately blank. Expected credit remains unavailable until all original group amounts are entered. Do not reuse C01 fees for a multi-ticket order.
Match A1/A2/B1 to stable original ticket IDs in ascending order within each shipping scope. Reverse sequence changes return order, not these original ranks.
Before returning any ticket in that run, mark the last original ticket fulfilled. If eligibility blocks fulfilled returns, mark that step Blocked; do not submit or infer a completed credit.
Flat-rate shipping is shared across types; per-group and per-item shipping is scoped to its original group. Last return in that scope releases the remaining charge and tax.
Allocate by stable original ticket rank using cumulative rounding. UnshippedOnly withholds fulfilled shares permanently; Proportional ignores fulfillment for amounts.
Per-item changes purchase shipping quantity; AfterAll still waits until all tickets in the stored shipping scope are returned. It is not automatically proportional.
If org fee + HST refunded is a hypothetical policy change. Current code excludes them. Correcting the excluded-fee display adds only organizer fee HST and never changes credit.
Enter actual credit per return step, order reference, and evidence. Compare preview, completed credit-balance change, and Transactions; do not mark Passed from preview alone.
Use owned test orders/test payments. Preserve original policy settings and restore them afterwards. Returns invalidate tickets and change credit; do not use shared customer orders.
This workbook covers shipping/fee permutations, not discounts, packages, gift cards, older-order fallback, fulfillment permission gates or shipping overrides.
